semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Hy-Lok specializes in ultra-high purity fluid and control components that are essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Hy-Lok is a leader in the fluid and control industry, providing ultra-high purity products such as fittings and valves crucial for semiconductor applications. With over 40 years of experience, the company focuses on delivering high-quality components that support the needs of semiconductor manufacturers.
